{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert `revenue` from string to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any sentinel values (e.g., 999999.99) — the earlier assertion failed, so let's inspect
sentinel_rows = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("Sentinel rows (revenue == 999999.99):")
print(sentinel_rows)

# Now filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue for this subset
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
